user_authorization_verbatim: 同意，我批准 runner 窗级输入拒绝契约的最小修订及针对性开发验证
scope: Only runner observer-window input refusal, corresponding registration validation/scoring and directly relevant development controls. Not fresh independent qualification.
contract: Use existing boundary.kind=frames_boundary, admission_expectation=rejected and boundary.expected_windows=not_ok plus actual unaltered sample bounds. No case-ID, pitch, seed or numeric-error special casing.

Every declared frames-boundary window remains present; W1 stays an ordinary observed window and the invalid W2 has an explicit runner input_refused record. Registration validation rejects missing W2, invalid statuses, duplicate windows and unregistered out-of-frame windows.

Check actual channels/sample count/rate against binding. Expected refusal requires a matching declared frame count and a valid positive interval whose stop exceeds that count. Incorrect/cropped PCM or undeclared invalid windows never pass.
No candidate FFT or observer/fit call for an input-refused window. Preserve original requested bounds and actual available samples, without clipping or padding.
Candidate helper rejects out-of-range windows instead of silently clipping.

Score complete per-window records independently against the registered request and actual count. Missing/mismatched/forged refusal, any probe attached to a refused window, and every unexpected observer exception stay failed. Refusal records are not observer ambiguity, scalar claims, interval certification or positive coverage.

Shared observe_partial interface and strict ValueError behavior, numeric/timing budgets, generator, PPA, evaluator/comparator, source-preserved consumed registrations/reports/seals/markers remain unchanged.
permanent_regression_purposes: Real candidate extraction refuses out-of-array windows and preserves a valid exact-end peak.
Runner window bookkeeping distinguishes planned refusal from undeclared invalid input and accidental PCM-length mismatch.
Missing, mismatched or forged window records and probes on refused windows cannot satisfy window scoring.
Valid-window observer errors remain hard failures, never expected refusal.
Static cross-lane validation rejects missing invalid-window coverage; unrelated existing unit tests keep their scientific/permission obligations.
test_fixture_cutover: Existing unit-suite registration is a private in-memory consumed-control fixture. Normalize frames-boundary observer window lists there and write any CLI input only in the test temporary directory; never modify a consumed registration on disk.

real_API_smoke.interface: Direct check_case_design/expected_binding/run_case with real shared observer and PPA/reference_quality, not main --role or any registered role.
